page.overview:
Who is Brene?

Brene was one of several Ubese exiles who were part of a bounty hunter crew led by Boushh. After Boushh rescued her from a rancor, she was the first member to join him.

Brene was a Ubese female bounty hunter who was a member of the crew led by fellow Ubese Boushh. By the time of the War of the Bounty Hunters, she had been exiled from Uba IV for seven years and a member of Boushh's crew for six. Boushh and Brene met when he rescued her from a rancor and told her to run; she then became the first to join him. Fellow exiles Ilini, Hareck, and Tans also joined the group.

Boushh's crew, including Brene, were hired by Silas Tagge, the brother of Lady Domina Tagge, to kill the Tagge Corporation's Executive Board in an attempted coup. Domina and her Honor Guard successfully thwarted her brother and she hired the crew for herself. Brene and the others protected their employer from another assassination attempt by Crimson Dawn and her nephew, Ronen Tagge; Lady Domina also defended herself with the Tagge protoblade. Tans remarked that their employer was terrifying and Brene enthusiastically agreed, leading Ilini to comment that the latter had bad taste.

Brene had a fondness for puns and telling jokes in the middle of a firefight. She also enjoyed sharing the story of how she met Boushh when he rescued her from a rancor.
